metadata.description: Spec-driven code generation plugins for Augentic.

plugins.name: rt
plugins.description: Skills to assist in the migration of TypeScript projects to Omnia Rust wasm32-wasip2 crates.

plugins.name: omnia
plugins.description: Skills to generate Omnia Rust wasm32-wasip2 crates.

plugins.name: client
plugins.description: Skills to generate client-facing deliverables — Statements of Work, proposals, pricing summaries, and similar artefacts — from Specify artifacts.

plugins.name: vectis
plugins.description: Skills to generate cross-platform Crux applications (Rust core, iOS shell, Android shell, design system).

plugins.name: spec
plugins.description: Skills for the Specify per-slice loop: init, define, build, merge, drop, and extract. Plan authoring and execution moved to the `change` plugin in RFC-13 §3.9; the plan-time analyze skill moved alongside (use /change:analyze). Use the three-skill change lifecycle (/change:draft, /change:execute, /change:finalize) for change-level orchestration.

plugins.name: change
plugins.description: Skills for Specify change orchestration: authors `plan.yaml` (`/change:draft`) and finalizes a completed change (`/change:finalize`); execution remains `/change:execute`. `/change:analyze` infers plan-time adapter summaries from legacy code or documentation inputs.

plugins.name: contract
plugins.description: Skills to author, import, and verify API/interface contracts — OpenAPI, AsyncAPI, JSON Schema, and future formats — from Specify artifacts.
